This apparatus is used to measure the strength of light in different places 
 using different sources of light such as tungsten, fluorescant, daylight or 
 mercury. The process of measurement depends on zero adjustment at first.

The first draft initiated by chem./ Nervana Fouad El Khouly, tested by chem./ 
 Gehan Abd EL-samiee, reviewed by Department director chem. Maha M.S. Hamoda 
 ,revised by quality control chem. Wael A.Tantawy at EDEPC and accepted by Eng. 
 Fathy Mahmoud Ragab head sector of Talkha Power Station.

This document is accepted by eng. 
 Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant, Mahmoud 
 M. Soliman, EDEPEC admin. and financial inspection, quality control General 
 Director and supervisor of inspection and quality control head sector.

The 
instrument has "Auto Power Shutt-off" in order to prolonged battery life. The 
meter will switch-off automatically if none of the buttons are pressed within 10 
minutes. To de-activate this feature, select memory record function during 
measurement by pressing "RECORD' button.

When the left 
corner of LCD display show "LBT", it is necessary to replace the battery. 
However, in-spec measurement may still be made for several hours after low 
battery indicator appears before the instrument become inaccurate.
